name: Fling
hint: Nobody to stand on? Get thrown.
why4: Three must be thrown onto the roof to hold the 3-plate that opens the pen with the crate, and the fourth throws them and then climbs on the crate; with three, only two reach the roof.
solution: P4 (nearest the gap) stands at x=16 (edge of the 2-wide gap at x=17-18); P3 stands beside P4, P4 grabs P3 and throws right: P3 lands on the roof (height 3, face at x=19). P4 throws P2 and then P1 the same way.
P1, P2, P3 stand on the plate at x=23-25 (3/3): pen gate A at x=9 opens.
P4 walks into the pen, grabs the crate at x=5, carries it to x=15 and puts it down at the gap's edge (hold Down + Grab), then fetches the key at x=2.
P4 hops onto the crate, runs off its far side and jumps onto the roof (the jump from the crate top clears the roof by 0.5, so take a run).
P4 sets the key down in front of P1 (P1 picks it up), or throws it ahead to whoever goes first.
Everyone jumps the 2-wide gap at x=31-32; P1 opens the door at x=40; all press Down.
Recovery: anyone falling in a gap respawns at the start and climbs via the crate; a crate that falls in returns to the pen (the three re-hold the plate).
